name: Digital Control of Power Converters Lab
description: Getting started with digital controller platforms, setting up and connecting with PC, running a sample program. Overview of DSP/FPGA. Getting conversant with the DSP programming/debugging platform and the overall architecture of DSP. Learning different modules in DSP– GPIO, clock and watchdog timer, interrupts – different types, their priorities, PIE, vector tables, interrupt service routines (ISR), ADC and DAC, their configuration, SOC, etc., ePWM, its configuration, deadtime, etc., HRPWM. Discrete-time implementation of controller – different types of transformations (backward Euler, forward Euler, Tustin/Bilinear, etc.), their advantages and disadvantages. Implementation of PLL. Implementation of PI, PID, and PR controllers. Implementation of low-pass, high-pass, and band-pass filters. Different digital realizations – direct form I, II, etc. Implementation of SPWM, SVPWM, THI SPWM.
